$comment: Machine-readable corporate-action capability records per provider family. Verified against current authoritative documentation on the dates below. Where a behaviour could not be established from authoritative sources it is 'UNKNOWN' and support is restricted. Do not infer. spec/corporate-action-model.md.

families.label: Coinbase tokenized stocks on Base
families.tokenStandard: B20 — an extension of ERC-20 (ERC-8056 for scheduled multiplier changes)
families.rawBalanceSemantics: balanceOf() returns raw B20 token units and is UNCHANGED by dividends and splits.
families.economicQuantitySemantics: scaledBalanceOf(account) = raw x multiplier / WAD. toScaledBalance(raw) / toRawBalance(scaled) convert. 'One B20 token does not permanently equal one share — always apply the current multiplier.'
families.corporateActionMechanism: A single WAD-scaled state variable `multiplier` (WAD_PRECISION() == 1e18). A split lifts the multiplier; a dividend lifts it as cash is reinvested into shares. Raw balances are held fixed.
families.activationModel: Scheduled path: updateUIMultiplier (ERC-8056) sets a future-dated change with advance on-chain notice, emits Announcement. Instant path: updateMultiplier (deprecated) applies immediately. During a corporate action the Chainlink feed freezes (registry pause flag set) and holds last-known-good; transfers remain unblocked on-chain.
families.transferBehavior: Transfers gated by a policy registry via isAuthorized(policyID, account). approve() is NOT policy-gated.
families.totalSupplySemantics: standard ERC-20; no special mechanics documented
families.priceConvention: FACTOR_IN_PRICE — the Chainlink 'Base Tokenized Equities (Coinbase B20)' feed reports Token Price = Underlying Equity Market Price x Multiplier. The multiplier is applied by the feed; consumers use rawBalance x feedPrice and must NOT also multiply by scaledBalanceOf.
families.existingCoreCustody: CONDITIONAL — balanceOf(vault) is stable across corporate actions so CollateralVault totalDeposited stays matched and I-01 holds. Needs an additive read adapter supplying raw quantity + a pinned CorporateActionSnapshot + feedStatus. No CollateralVault change.

feed decimals and heartbeat (Chainlink doc did not state them in the pages read)
whether the policy registry can freeze transfers of an already-held balance during an action

sources.note: B20 mechanics: multiplier WAD-scaled, scaledBalanceOf/toScaledBalance/toRawBalance, updateUIMultiplier vs updateMultiplier, feed freeze during action
feed price = underlying x multiplier, multiplier applied by the feed, pause holds last-known-good
B20 keeps balanceOf fixed while the multiplier adjusts the redeemable claim

families.label: xStocks tracker certificates (Backed Finance)
families.issuerOperator: Backed Finance AG (issuer and token-mechanics operator)
families.network: Solana and EVM chains including X Layer mainnet (eip155:196); official issuer-token availability on X Layer testnet (eip155:1952) is unverified and must not be assumed
families.tokenStandard: ERC-20 on EVM, with an internal multiplier applied inside balanceOf()
families.rawBalanceSemantics: There is a 'Raw Balance' internally, but on EVM chains the smart contract applies the multiplier internally and balanceOf() returns the ALREADY-ADJUSTED (equity-adjusted) balance.
families.economicQuantitySemantics: effective = balanceOf() directly on EVM. scaled amount = raw x multiplier. Current and historical multiplier via api.xstocks.fi/api/v2/public/assets/{SYMBOL}/multiplier[/history]?network={NETWORK}.
families.corporateActionMechanism: A global on-chain Multiplier linking each holder's Raw Balance to its current custody-share entitlement. A split lifts the Multiplier proportionally; a dividend lifts it further as the issuer reinvests cash into shares; a reverse split lowers it (2-for-1 reverse split example: 4.032 -> 2.016). No per-holder mint or burn.
families.activationModel: The multiplier is published on-chain BEFORE each corporate event, with activation set for 00:30 UTC on the day immediately following the Ex-Date.
families.transferBehavior: ERC-20 transfer of the adjusted balance; issuer compliance controls exist (mark UNKNOWN pending contract inspection).
families.decimals: UNKNOWN — multiplier values are non-integer (4.032, 2.016); on-chain fixed-point precision not established from the docs read. Treat as UNKNOWN until the contract is inspected; use conservative handling.
families.totalSupplySemantics: UNKNOWN whether totalSupply is raw or adjusted on EVM
families.priceConvention: UNKNOWN — needs the exact xStocks price feed semantics for the target domain. Until established, treat as FACTOR_IN_QUANTITY with effective = balanceOf() and require a raw underlying-share feed, or RESTRICT.
families.existingCoreCustody: NO — balanceOf(vault) changes on a corporate action. A positive rebase orphans value in CollateralVault.surplus; a negative rebase (reverse split) makes held < totalDeposited and breaks I-01. Requires the additive SHARE_BASED_CUSTODY V2 vault (spec/corporate-action-model.md §8), deployed with a domain in Phase 09.
